nodes.name: createConflictDecorations
nodes.summary: Builds CodeMirror decorations (block widgets and line classes) that render conflict action buttons and current/incoming inline labels around each parsed conflict block.

nodes.name: hasConflictMarkers
nodes.summary: Quick regex check for whether a content string still contains unresolved conflict markers.

nodes.name: useConflictMarkers
nodes.summary: Hook exposing parsed conflicts, resolution counts, and resolveConflict/getResolvedContent helpers derived from file content.

nodes.name: CodeMirrorDiff
nodes.summary: Renders a unified or split CodeMirror diff view with merge controls, collapsible unchanged regions, absolute line-number gutters, selection tracking, and change callbacks.

nodes.name: getLineCount
nodes.summary: Fast line counter using byte scanning, used to decide when to disable expensive editor features for large files.

nodes.name: createCustomLinterExtension
nodes.summary: Wraps a caller-provided synchronous linter function as a CodeMirror lint() extension, converting and reporting diagnostics.

nodes.name: toCodeMirrorDiagnostic
nodes.summary: Converts a single app Diagnostic into a CodeMirror Diagnostic, clamping offsets to valid document positions.

nodes.name: convertAndSortDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Maps a diagnostics array through toCodeMirrorDiagnostic, drops invalid entries, and sorts the result by document position.

nodes.name: withTimeout
nodes.summary: Races a promise against a timeout, resolving to a fallback value if the promise doesn't settle in time.

nodes.name: createLinterExtension
nodes.summary: Chooses between LSP-backed and custom linting based on whether the file's language has LSP support, returning the resulting CodeMirror linter extension.

nodes.name: createLspLinterExtension
nodes.summary: Builds a CodeMirror ViewPlugin that manages LSP client lifecycle, combines LSP and ESLint diagnostics, retries failed LSP initialization with exponential backoff, and tracks linter health state.

nodes.name: useCopyExtension
nodes.summary: Hook returning a CodeMirror domEventHandlers extension that prepends a file-reference header to text copied from the editor.

nodes.name: useCursorExtension
nodes.summary: Hook returning a CodeMirror updateListener extension that reports the current cursor line/column via a callback on each editor update.

nodes.name: useEditorExtensions
nodes.summary: Hook that assembles the complete ordered list of CodeMirror extensions (theme, gutters, folding, linting, keymaps, minimap, dirty-diff, git blame) for a given file.

nodes.name: useLargeFileHandling
nodes.summary: Hook computing content line count and returning flags for which expensive editor features (minimap, indent guides, etc.) should be disabled for large files.

nodes.name: useLazyLanguageExtension
nodes.summary: Hook that returns a language extension synchronously from cache when available, and lazily imports/loads it asynchronously otherwise.

nodes.name: createSelectionExtension
nodes.summary: Builds a CodeMirror domEventHandlers extension that detects a 'held' text selection (mouse held after selecting) and invokes a callback with selection text/position.

nodes.name: useSelectionExtension
nodes.summary: Hook wrapping createSelectionExtension in a memoized CodeMirror extension keyed by the onSelectionHold callback.

nodes.name: rememberEditorScrollTop
nodes.summary: Persists an editor's current scrollTop into an in-memory map keyed by a scroll-state key, so it can be restored later.

nodes.name: restoreEditorScrollTop
nodes.summary: Restores a previously remembered scrollTop onto a CodeMirror view across animation frames, retrying until content is scrollable.

nodes.name: CodeMirrorEditor
nodes.summary: Primary code editor component wiring theme, extensions, and the copy/cursor/selection/large-file/lazy-language hooks together, restoring scroll position and forwarding change/selection callbacks.

nodes.name: createCopyFileRefExtension
nodes.summary: Factory building a CodeMirror extension that intercepts the copy event to prepend a file-reference comment to copied text.

nodes.name: getLanguageKey
nodes.summary: Derives a normalized cache key for a file's language extension from its file path or an explicit language override.

nodes.name: getLanguageExtension
nodes.summary: Async resolver returning the CodeMirror language-mode extension for a file, using cached results or loading the extension on demand.

nodes.name: getLanguageExtensionSync
nodes.summary: Synchronous variant that returns a cached language extension immediately, or null if it hasn't been loaded/cached yet.

nodes.name: loadLanguageExtension
nodes.summary: Dynamically imports and instantiates the CodeMirror language package for a given language key, caching the result for future lookups.
